info.title: Flight
info.description:
The Flight APIs are endpoints that contains flight search, confirmation, booking and cancellation resources.



> Before you proceed, we recommend you read our [Authentication documentation](https://docs.tiqwa.com/docs/tiqwa/reference/Authentication.v1.json) to understand how to get authenticated and generate access tokens.

> Sandbox Base URL: https://sandbox.tiqwa.com/v1/flight 

> Production Base URL: https://prod.tiqwa.com/v1/flight

get.description:
This endpoint returns available flights for a specfied route and date.

> Be aware that our sandbox environment is based on a cache of the production, if no results are returned try popular airports like LHR (London) to JFK (New-York) and future dates.

parameters.name: flexible_date
parameters.description: If flexible date is passed to this endpoint, it returns the result +/-3 days from the search date

document_required.description: Is travel document required for booking the flight

price_change.description:
Has flight price changed, when compared with the initial result returned from the flight search result.
This is useful if you plan to make an action or alert user of flight change, before proceeding to booking.

total_duration.description: Total duration of flight in Minutes

total_inbound_duration.description: Total duration of flight for return segment

travelers_price.description: Price breakdown for the individual travelers

value.message: The flight is not available for booking

get.description: This endpoint confirms the availability and price of a flight result. It returns the same flight search data with additional information, like ```bookable_seats```, ```price_change```, ```expires_at```, ```document_required```

value.message: This flight is no longer available for booking

post.description:
This endpoint creates an order/booking for a specified ```Flight ID```. 
> Though it's possible to book a flight directly from the Flight search endpoint, but we recommend you confirm pricing first. This helps to eliminate pricing error, and makes sure that any price change is updated before booking.

dob.description:
Passenger date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)

> Adult date of birth is within 12 years and above

> Child date of birth is between 2 - 11 years

> Infant date of birth is below 2 years

documents.description: Passenger's travel document details. This isonly required when ```document_required``` fieldfrom the ```price confirmation``` endpoint is ```true```

expiry_date.description:
Document expiry date (YYYY-DD-MM) 

> Booking will fail if travel document is expired

nationality_country.description: Passenger country of Nationality in [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)

document_type.description:
Type of travel document
> Only ```passport``` is accepted currently

holder.description: Does the document details belong to the passenger?

outbound.description: Total number of stops for returning trip. null is returned when trip is a

outbound_stops.description: Total number of stops for departing trip

price_change.description: Did price change before final booking?

status.description:
Status of booking

Reserved status: indicates the flight has been boooked but no ticket has been issued yet.

Issued status: indicates the flight has been booked and ticket has been issued forthe flight. When the status is ```issued``` the response has tickets fields showing the ticket number of passenger(s)

total_duration.description: Total duration of flight trip in minutes

total_inbound_duration.description: Total time for returning trip in minutes. null is returned when trip is a oneway trip.

total_outbound_duration.description: Total time for departing trip in minutes

travelers_price.description: Price breakdown for the individual travelers

get.description:
This endpoint returns the details of a provided flight booking ```reference``` of an authenticated company.

> Providing a ```reference``` not associated with your account also returns a ```404 (Not Found)``` status code

value.message: This booking has been previously cancelled

post.description:
This endpoint cancels a provided flight booking ```reference```

> Cancelled flight booking can not be reissued

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Booking reference gotten from the book endpoint.

value.message: Ticket issuing is processing, your ticket will be updated once succesful

example-1.message: Your wallet balance is too low to issue this ticket, please fund your ticket wallet and try again

value.message: Your wallet balance is too low to issue this ticket, please fund your ticket wallet and try again
This itinerary has already been issued
Duplicate issuing. This itinerary is still processing booking. Please wait for booking status to update

post.description:
This endpoint issues a reserved flight ticket. The reference must belong to you, this means you can not issue a ticket reserved by a different account.

> This requires that your ticket wallet is funded and the balance is not below the payable amount of the booking.

This endpoint searches for multi city flights. 

> The maximum number of routes to be searched is 6 routes

duration.description: Flight Duration for particular segment in minutes

layover.description: Time (in minutes) between the arrival at an airport and departure to the next route

holder.description: Is traveler the holder/owner of document?

nationality_country.description: Passenger country of Nationality in [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)

Bearer.description: Access token generated from your Tiqwa dashboard
